items.source: It is not possible to change the _id of existing documents with a replace operation. On upsert MongoDB uses 2 ways of determining the new id for the entry: * The _id is used within the query as in {"_id" : 1234 } * The _id is present in the replacement document. If no _id is provided in either way, MongoDB will create a new ObjectId for the document. This may lead to mapping and data lookup malfunctions if the used domain types id property has a different type like e.g. Long.
items.translation: 无法通过替换操作更改现有文档的 `_id`。 在 `upsert` 操作中，MongoDB 采用以下两种方式来确定新条目的 ID： * 在查询中使用 `_id`，例如 `{"_id" : 1234 }`； * 替换文档中包含 `_id`。 如果以上两种方式均未提供 `_id`，MongoDB 将为该文档生成一个新的 `ObjectId`。 这可能导致映射和数据查找出现问题，特别是当使用的领域类型中 `id` 属性的类型不同（例如为 `Long`）时。

items.source: MongoTemplate / ReactiveMongoTemplate let you save, update, and delete your domain objects and map those objects to documents stored in MongoDB. The API signatures of the imperative and reactive API are mainly the same only differing in their return types. While the synchronous API uses void, single Object and List the reactive counterpart consists of Mono<Void>, Mono<Object> and Flux.
items.translation: MongoTemplate 和 ReactiveMongoTemplate 允许您保存、更新和删除领域对象，并将这些对象映射到存储在 MongoDB 中的文档。命令式和响应式 API 的签名基本相同，仅在返回类型上有所区别。同步 API 使用 void、单个 Object 和 List，而对应的响应式版本则使用 Mono<Void>、Mono<Object> 和 Flux。

items.source: Some environments require a customized approach to map Id values such as data stored in MongoDB that did not run through the Spring Data mapping layer. Documents can contain _id values that can be represented either as ObjectId or as String. Reading documents from the store back to the domain type works just fine. Querying for documents via their id can be cumbersome due to the implicit ObjectId conversion. Therefore documents cannot be retrieved that way. For those cases @MongoId provides more control over the actual id mapping attempts.
items.translation: 某些环境需要采用定制化的方法来映射 `Id` 值，例如存储在 MongoDB 中且未经过 Spring Data 映射层处理的数据。文档可能包含 `_id` 值，这些值可以表示为 `ObjectId` 或 `String`。从存储中读取文档并转换回领域类型的工作正常。然而，通过其 `id` 查询文档可能会很繁琐，因为存在隐式的 `ObjectId` 转换问题，因此无法以这种方式检索文档。对于这些情况，`@MongoId` 提供了对实际 id 映射尝试的更多控制。

Read more in the Optimistic Locking section.

有关更多信息，请参阅乐观锁部分。

items.source: When inserting or saving, if the Id property is not set, the assumption is that its value will be auto-generated by the database. Consequently, for auto-generation of an ObjectId to succeed, the type of the Id property or field in your class must be a String, an ObjectId, or a BigInteger.
items.translation: 在插入或保存时，如果未设置 `Id` 属性，则假定其值将由数据库自动生成。因此，若要成功自动生成本类中的 `Id` 属性或字段的 `ObjectId`，该属性的类型必须是 `String`、`ObjectId` 或 `BigInteger`。

items.translation: Update currentTimestamp (String key) 使用 $currentDate 更新修饰符，并将 $type 设置为 timestamp。

items.source: Update methods exposed by MongoOperations and ReactiveMongoOperations also accept an Aggregation Pipeline via AggregationUpdate. Using AggregationUpdate allows leveraging MongoDB 4.2 aggregations in an update operation. Using aggregations in an update allows updating one or more fields by expressing multiple stages and multiple conditions with a single operation.
items.translation: `MongoOperations`和`ReactiveMongoOperations`暴露的更新方法也通过`AggregationUpdate`接受聚合管道。使用`AggregationUpdate`可以在更新操作中利用MongoDB 4.2 的聚合功能。在更新操作中使用聚合允许通过单个操作表达多个阶段和多个条件，从而更新一个或多个字段。

items.source: If possible, an id property or field declared as a String in the Java class is converted to and stored as an ObjectId by using a Spring Converter<String, ObjectId>. Valid conversion rules are delegated to the MongoDB Java driver. If it cannot be converted to an ObjectId, then the value is stored as a string in the database.
items.translation: 如果可能，Java 类中声明为 String 的 id 属性或字段会通过 Spring 的 Converter<String, ObjectId> 转换为 ObjectId 并存储。有效的转换规则由 MongoDB Java 驱动委托处理。如果无法转换为 ObjectId，则该值将以字符串形式存储在数据库中。

items.source: There are several convenient methods on MongoTemplate for saving and inserting your objects. To have more fine-grained control over the conversion process, you can register Spring converters with the MappingMongoConverter — for example Converter<Person, Document> and Converter<Document, Person>.
items.translation:
在 `MongoTemplate` 上存在几种便捷的方法来保存和插入对象。  
若需对转换过程进行更精细的控制，您可以向 `MappingMongoConverter` 注册 Spring 转换器——例如 `Converter<Person, Document>` 和 `Converter<Document, Person>`。

items.source: MongoDB requires that you have an _id field for all documents. If you do not provide one, the driver assigns an ObjectId with a generated value without considering your domain model as the server isn’t aware of your identifier type. When you use the MappingMongoConverter, certain rules govern how properties from the Java class are mapped to this _id field:
items.translation: MongoDB 要求所有文档都必须包含一个 `_id` 字段。 如果您未提供该字段，驱动程序会分配一个 `ObjectId` 并生成一个值，而不会考虑您的领域模型，因为服务器并不了解您的标识符类型。 当您使用 `MappingMongoConverter` 时，某些规则将决定如何从 Java 类属性映射到该 `_id` 字段：

items.translation: Java 类中声明为 BigInteger 的 id 属性或字段，将通过使用 Spring 的 Converter<BigInteger, ObjectId> 转换为 ObjectId 并存储。

items.source: There are two ways to manage the collection name that is used for the documents. The default collection name that is used is the class name changed to start with a lower-case letter. So a com.test.Person class is stored in the person collection. You can customize this by providing a different collection name with the @Document annotation. You can also override the collection name by providing your own collection name as the last parameter for the selected MongoTemplate method calls.
items.translation: 管理文档所用集合名称有两种方式。默认情况下，使用的集合名称是将类名转换为以小写字母开头，因此com.test.Person类会被存储在person集合中。您可以通过使用@Document注解提供不同的集合名称来自定义此行为。此外，您还可以在选定的MongoTemplate方法调用中将自定义集合名称作为最后一个参数来覆盖集合名称。

items.source: The @Version annotation provides syntax similar to that of JPA in the context of MongoDB and makes sure updates are only applied to documents with a matching version. Therefore, the actual value of the version property is added to the update query in such a way that the update does not have any effect if another operation altered the document in the meantime. In that case, an OptimisticLockingFailureException is thrown. The following example shows these features:

items.source: 1 Remove a single entity specified by its _id from the associated collection. 2 Remove all documents that match the criteria of the query from the GOT collection. 3 Remove the first three documents in the GOT collection. Unlike <2>, the documents to remove are identified by their _id, running the given query, applying sort, limit, and skip options first, and then removing all at once in a separate step. 4 Remove all documents matching the criteria of the query from the GOT collection. Unlike <3>, documents do not get deleted in a batch but one by one. 5 Remove the first three documents in the GOT collection. Unlike <3>, documents do not get deleted in a batch but one by one.
items.translation: 1 根据指定的 _id 从关联集合中删除单个实体。 2 从 GOT 集合中删除所有匹配查询条件的文档。 3 删除 GOT 集合中的前三个文档。与 <2> 不同，要删除的文档是通过其 _id 来标识的：首先运行给定查询并应用 sort、limit 和 skip 选项，然后在单独的步骤中一次性删除所有匹配的文档。 4 从 GOT 集合中删除所有匹配查询条件的文档。与 <3> 不同，文档不是批量删除，而是逐个删除。 5 删除 GOT 集合中的前三个文档。与 <3> 不同，文档不是批量删除，而是逐个删除。

items.source: 1 Use the fluent update API with the domain type given for mapping the query and deriving the collection name or just use MongoOperations#findAndReplace. 2 The actual match query mapped against the given domain type. Provide sort, fields and collation settings via the query. 3 Additional optional hook to provide options other than the defaults, like upsert. 4 An optional projection type used for mapping the operation result. If none given the initial domain type is used. 5 Trigger the actual processing. Use findAndReplaceValue to obtain the nullable result instead of an Optional.
items.translation: 1 使用流式更新 API 配合给定的域类型来映射查询并推导集合名称，或直接使用 MongoOperations#findAndReplace。 2 针对给定域类型进行实际匹配查询。 通过查询提供 sort、fields 和 collation 设置。 3 额外的可选钩子，用于提供除默认值之外的选项，例如 upsert。 4 一个用于映射操作结果的可选投影类型。 如果未提供，则使用初始域类型。 5 触发实际处理。 使用 findAndReplaceValue 获取可空结果，而不是 Optional。

items.source: 1 Initially insert document. version is set to 0. 2 Load the just inserted document. version is still 0. 3 Update the document with version = 0. Set the lastname and bump version to 1. 4 Try to update the previously loaded document that still has version = 0. The operation fails with an OptimisticLockingFailureException, as the current version is 1.
items.translation: 1 最初插入文档。version 被设置为 0。 2 加载刚刚插入的文档。version 仍然是 0。 3 使用 version = 0 更新文档。 设置 lastname 并将 version 递增为 1。 4 尝试更新之前加载的文档，该文档仍具有 version = 0。 由于当前的 version 为 1，操作失败并抛出 OptimisticLockingFailureException。

items.source: 1 The 1st $set stage calculates a new field average based on the average of the tests field. 2 The 2nd $set stage calculates a new field grade based on the average field calculated by the first aggregation stage. 3 The pipeline is run on the students collection and uses Student for the aggregation field mapping. 4 Apply the update to all matching documents in the collection.
items.translation: 1 第一个 $set 阶段根据 tests 字段的平均值计算出一个新字段 average。 2 第二个 $set 阶段根据第一个聚合阶段计算的 average 字段计算出一个新字段 grade。 3 该管道在 students 集合上运行，并使用 Student 进行聚合字段映射。 4 将更新应用于集合中所有匹配的文档。

items.source: 1 The _id value needs to be present for upsert, otherwise MongoDB will create a new potentially with the domain type incompatible ObjectId. As MongoDB is not aware of your domain type, any @Field(targetType) hints are not considered and the resulting ObjectId might be not compatible with your domain model. 2 Use upsert to insert a new document if no match is found
items.translation: 1 执行更新或插入（upsert）操作时，必须包含 _id 值；否则 MongoDB 可能会创建一个与您的领域类型不兼容的潜在新 ObjectId。由于 MongoDB 无法感知您的领域类型，任何 @Field(targetType) 提示都将被忽略，由此生成的 ObjectId 可能与您的领域模型不兼容。 2 使用 upsert 在找不到匹配项时插入新文档。

items.source: As of Version 2.2 MongoOperations also includes the @Version property when removing an entity from the database. To remove a Document without version check use MongoOperations#remove(Query,…​) instead of MongoOperations#remove(Object).
items.translation: 自 2.2 版本起，MongoOperations 在从数据库中删除实体时也会包含 @Version 属性。 若要移除无需版本检查的 Document，请使用 MongoOperations#remove(Query,…​) 替代 MongoOperations#remove(Object)。

items.source: Please note that the replacement must not hold an id itself as the id of the existing Document will be carried over to the replacement by the store itself. Also keep in mind that findAndReplace will only replace the first document matching the query criteria depending on a potentially given sort order.
items.translation: 请注意，替换项本身不应包含 id，因为现有 Document 的 id 将由存储系统自动传递到替换项中。 此外，请牢记 findAndReplace 仅会根据可能提供的排序顺序，替换匹配查询条件的第一份文档。

items.source: updateFirst does not support ordering for MongoDB Versions below 8.0. Running one of the older versions, please use findAndModify to apply Sort.
items.translation: updateFirst 不支持 MongoDB 8.0 以下版本的排序。如果您使用的是旧版本，请使用 findAndModify 来应用 Sort。

items.source: upsert does not support ordering. Please use findAndModify to apply Sort.
items.translation: upsert 不支持排序。 请使用 findAndModify 来应用 Sort。

items.source: As of Version 2.2 repositories check for the outcome of acknowledged deletes when removing versioned entities. An OptimisticLockingFailureException is raised if a versioned entity cannot be deleted through CrudRepository.delete(Object). In such case, the version was changed or the object was deleted in the meantime. Use CrudRepository.deleteById(ID) to bypass optimistic locking functionality and delete objects regardless of their version.
items.translation: 自版本 2.2 起，仓库在删除带版本控制的实体时会检查已确认删除的结果。 如果无法通过 CrudRepository.delete(Object) 删除带版本控制的实体，则会抛出 OptimisticLockingFailureException。 在这种情况下，该实体的版本可能已被更改，或者该对象在此期间已被删除。 请使用 CrudRepository.deleteById(ID) 绕过乐观锁机制，无论对象的版本如何均执行删除操作。

items.source: MongoDB requires that you have an _id field for all documents. Please refer to the ID handling section for details on the special treatment of this field.
items.translation: MongoDB 要求所有文档都必须包含一个 _id 字段。有关该字段的特殊处理方式，请参阅ID 处理部分以获取详细信息。

items.source: Optimistic Locking requires write acknowledgement (a write result response) by the server. Using WriteConcern.UNACKNOWLEDGED can lead to silently swallowed OptimisticLockingFailureException.
items.translation: 乐观锁需要服务器端的写确认（即写结果响应）。使用 WriteConcern.UNACKNOWLEDGED 可能导致 OptimisticLockingFailureException 异常被静默吞没。

items.source: MongoDB collections can contain documents that represent instances of a variety of types. Please refer to the type mapping for details.
items.translation: MongoDB 集合可以包含代表多种类型实例的文档。有关详细信息，请参阅类型映射。

items.source: Index hints for the update operation can be provided via Query.withHint(…​).
items.translation: 可以通过 Query.withHint(…​) 为更新操作提供索引提示。

items.source: The difference between insert and save operations is that a save operation performs an insert if the object is not already present.
items.translation: 插入和保存操作的区别在于：如果对象尚未存在，保存操作会执行插入。
